_meta.method: CTG 机械抽取 (design_card_raw.json) + 公司 PR/deck 人工核对；每条事实挂 evidence.csv claim_id

design.masking: double-blind placebo-controlled (DBPC, Part A, 72w) + open-label extension (Part B/ATE, 48w)

population.main_cohort: biopsy-proven non-cirrhotic MASH, central reading SAF A3/A4 + F2/F3
population.glp1_sglt2: stable dose >=3 months allowed; GLP-1 initiation after randomization allowed

primary_endpoint.verbatim: Resolution of NASH and improvement of fibrosis at Week 72, defined by NASH CRN scores for ballooning of 0 and inflammation of 0 to 1, and fibrosis score ≥1 stage decrease compared to Baseline
key_secondaries: MASH resolution with no worsening of fibrosis
fibrosis improvement with no worsening of MASH

multiplicity.note: 未公开；基线假设，矩阵含固定顺序/须同时显著

interim_alpha_spend.note: 未见任何 efficacy interim 证据；5 次 DMC 均为安全性审查

test.note: 分层因素见 C07；以两比例 z 近似

missing_biopsy.note: MASH 领域惯例；矩阵含 MI
